title: dactylis glomerata f. ciliata
intro: Dactylis glomerata f. ciliata, commonly known as Ciliated Orchard Grass or Hair-awned Cock's-foot, is a subspecies of the Dactylis glomerata plant, a type of perennial grass. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Dactylis glomerata f. ciliata include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
